headline: GE Power India Limited: NCLT Convened Unsecured Creditors' Meeting – E-Voting Results
sum: GE Power India held an NCLT-convened meeting of unsecured creditors on 20 July 2026 to vote on a restructuring/scheme of arrangement; the consolidated scrutinizer's report on e-voting results (remote and in-person ballots) was filed with NSE on 21 July 2026.
detail: GE Power India Limited, a subsidiary of General Electric operating in India's power generation sector, convened a meeting of its unsecured creditors under NCLT jurisdiction to seek approval for a scheme of arrangement or restructuring proposal. The meeting was held on 20 July 2026 at 4:30 p.m. IST. Voting occurred both remotely and in-person. The scrutinizer's consolidated report on e-voting outcomes was formally reported to NSE (stock exchange listing disclosure) on 21 July 2026, indicating the scheme required shareholder and creditor approval.
